class Canvas
  def initialize(width, height)
    @width = width
    @height = height
    @rows = Array.new(height) { Array.new(width, ' ') }
  end

  def position(x, y, denominator = 1)
    column = (2 * x * (@width - 1) + 1000 * denominator) / (2000 * denominator)
    row = @height - 1 - (2 * y * (@height - 1) + 1000 * denominator) / (2000 * denominator)
    [column, row]
  end

  def mark(point, character)
    column, row = position(*point)
    @rows[row][column] = character
  end

  def line(first, second, character)
    x, y = position(*first)
    end_x, end_y = position(*second)
    dx = (end_x - x).abs
    dy = -(end_y - y).abs
    step_x = x < end_x ? 1 : -1
    step_y = y < end_y ? 1 : -1
    error = dx + dy
    loop do
      @rows[y][x] = character
      break if x == end_x && y == end_y

      twice_error = 2 * error
      if twice_error >= dy
        error += dy
        x += step_x
      end
      if twice_error <= dx
        error += dx
        y += step_y
      end
    end
  end

  def draw_voronoi(points)
    horizontal = @width - 1
    vertical = @height - 1
    owners = Array.new(@height) do |row|
      Array.new(@width) do |column|
        (1...points.size).min_by do |site|
          x, y = points[site]
          dx = (column * 1000 - x * horizontal) * vertical
          dy = ((vertical - row) * 1000 - y * vertical) * horizontal
          [dx * dx + dy * dy, site]
        end
      end
    end
    @height.times do |row|
      @width.times do |column|
        owner = owners[row][column]
        right_differs = column < horizontal && owner != owners[row][column + 1]
        below_differs = row < vertical && owner != owners[row + 1][column]
        @rows[row][column] = '#' if right_differs || below_differs
      end
    end
    points.drop(1).each { |point| mark(point, 'o') }
  end

  def framed
    border = '+' + '-' * @width + '+'
    [border, *@rows.map { |row| '|' + row.join + '|' }, border]
  end
end

module Predicates
  extend self

  def orient(p, q, r)
    (q[0] - p[0]) * (r[1] - p[1]) - (q[1] - p[1]) * (r[0] - p[0])
  end

  def d2(p, q)
    (p[0] - q[0])**2 + (p[1] - q[1])**2
  end

  def dot(o, p, q)
    (p[0] - o[0]) * (q[0] - o[0]) + (p[1] - o[1]) * (q[1] - o[1])
  end

  def incircle(a, b, c, d)
    ax, ay = a[0] - d[0], a[1] - d[1]
    bx, by = b[0] - d[0], b[1] - d[1]
    cx, cy = c[0] - d[0], c[1] - d[1]
    aa, bb, cc = ax * ax + ay * ay, bx * bx + by * by, cx * cx + cy * cy
    ax * (by * cc - bb * cy) - ay * (bx * cc - bb * cx) + aa * (bx * cy - by * cx)
  end

  def circumcenter(a, b, c)
    bx, by = b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]
    cx, cy = c[0] - a[0], c[1] - a[1]
    bb, cc = bx * bx + by * by, cx * cx + cy * cy
    denominator = 2 * (bx * cy - by * cx)
    x = a[0] * denominator + cy * bb - by * cc
    y = a[1] * denominator + bx * cc - cx * bb
    [x, y, denominator]
  end

  def fraction(numerator, denominator)
    common = numerator.gcd(denominator)
    numerator /= common
    denominator /= common
    denominator == 1 ? numerator.to_s : "#{numerator}/#{denominator}"
  end

  def reduce_direction(dx, dy)
    common = dx.gcd(dy)
    [dx / common, dy / common]
  end
end

require_relative 'predicates'

module Proximity
  extend self
  include Predicates

  class DisjointSets
    attr_reader :count

    def initialize(size)
      @parent = (0..size).to_a
      @size = Array.new(size + 1, 1)
      @count = size
    end

    def find(site)
      until @parent[site] == site
        @parent[site] = @parent[@parent[site]]
        site = @parent[site]
      end
      site
    end

    def union(first, second)
      first, second = find(first), find(second)
      return false if first == second

      first, second = second, first if @size[first] < @size[second]
      @parent[second] = first
      @size[first] += @size[second]
      @count -= 1
      true
    end
  end

  def nearest_neighbors(points, neighbors)
    points.each_index.map do |site|
      neighbors[site].min_by { |other| [d2(points[site], points[other]), other] } if site.positive?
    end
  end

  def nearest_components(nearest)
    sets = DisjointSets.new(nearest.size - 1)
    (1...nearest.size).each { |site| sets.union(site, nearest[site]) }
    (1...nearest.size).group_by { |site| sets.find(site) }.values.sort_by(&:first)
  end

  def kruskal(points, edges)
    sets = DisjointSets.new(points.size - 1)
    edges.sort_by { |i, j| [d2(points[i], points[j]), i, j] }.select do |i, j|
      sets.union(i, j)
    end
  end

  def gabriel_edge?(points, edge, directed)
    i, j = edge
    [edge, [j, i]].all? do |direction|
      opposite = directed[direction]
      !opposite || dot(points[opposite], points[i], points[j]).positive?
    end
  end

  def relative_neighbor_edge?(points, edge)
    i, j = edge
    length2 = d2(points[i], points[j])
    points.drop(1).none? { |p| d2(points[i], p) < length2 && d2(points[j], p) < length2 }
  end

  def greedy_route(points, neighbors, start, target)
    route = [start]
    length = 0.0
    current = start
    until current == target
      following = neighbors[current].min_by { |site| [d2(points[site], points[target]), site] }
      length += Math.sqrt(d2(points[current], points[following]))
      route << following
      current = following
    end
    [route, length]
  end

  def dijkstra(points, neighbors, start)
    distances = Array.new(points.size, Float::INFINITY)
    previous = Array.new(points.size)
    distances[start] = 0.0
    remaining = (1...points.size).to_a
    until remaining.empty?
      site = remaining.min_by { |vertex| distances[vertex] }
      remaining.delete(site)
      neighbors[site].each do |other|
        candidate = distances[site] + Math.sqrt(d2(points[site], points[other]))
        next unless candidate < distances[other]

        distances[other] = candidate
        previous[other] = site
      end
    end
    [distances, previous]
  end
end

require 'set'
require_relative 'predicates'

class Triangulation
  include Predicates

  attr_reader :directed, :initial

  def initialize(points)
    @points = points
    @directed = {}
    @initial = orient(points[1], points[2], points[3]).positive? ? [1, 2, 3] : [1, 3, 2]
    add(*@initial)
  end

  def canonical(a, b, c)
    [[a, b, c], [b, c, a], [c, a, b]].min
  end

  def triangles
    @directed.map { |(a, b), c| canonical(a, b, c) }.uniq.sort
  end

  def hull_edges
    @directed.keys.select { |u, v| !@directed.key?([v, u]) }.sort
  end

  def insert(site)
    containing = triangles.find do |a, b, c|
      [[a, b], [b, c], [c, a]].all? do |u, v|
        orient(@points[u], @points[v], @points[site]).positive?
      end
    end
    visible = 0
    if containing
      a, b, c = containing
      remove(a, b, c)
      check = Set[[a, b], [b, c], [c, a]]
      kind = 'inside'
    else
      check = hull_edges.filter_map do |u, v|
        [v, u] if orient(@points[u], @points[v], @points[site]).negative?
      end.to_set
      visible = check.size
      kind = 'outside'
    end
    check.each { |a, b| add(a, b, site) }

    flips = 0
    until check.empty?
      a, b = check.first
      check.delete([a, b])
      q = @directed[[b, a]]
      next unless q && incircle(@points[a], @points[b], @points[site], @points[q]).positive?

      remove(a, b, site)
      remove(b, a, q)
      add(a, q, site)
      add(q, b, site)
      check.add([a, q])
      check.add([q, b])
      flips += 1
    end
    { kind: kind, containing: containing, visible: visible, flips: flips,
      triangle_count: @directed.size / 3, hull_count: hull_edges.size }
  end

  def visibility_walk(query, triangles, edge_triangles)
    path = [1]
    loop do
      a, b, c = triangles[path.last]
      crossed = [[a, b], [b, c], [c, a]].find do |u, v|
        orient(@points[u], @points[v], query).negative?
      end
      return [path, nil] unless crossed

      u, v = crossed
      following = edge_triangles[[v, u]]
      return [path, [u, v].sort] unless following

      path << following
    end
  end

  private

  def add(a, b, c)
    @directed[[a, b]] = c
    @directed[[b, c]] = a
    @directed[[c, a]] = b
  end

  def remove(a, b, c)
    @directed.delete([a, b])
    @directed.delete([b, c])
    @directed.delete([c, a])
  end
end

require_relative 'predicates'

module Voronoi
  extend self
  include Predicates

  def squared_radius(a, b, c)
    l1, l2, l3 = [d2(a, b), d2(b, c), d2(c, a)].map(&:to_f)
    area2 = orient(a, b, c).to_f
    ((l1 * l2) * l3) / ((4.0 * area2) * area2)
  end

  def position(center, points, hull)
    x, y, denominator = center
    on = false
    hull.each_with_index do |u, index|
      v = hull[(index + 1) % hull.size]
      ux, uy = points[u]
      vx, vy = points[v]
      sigma = (vx - ux) * (y - uy * denominator) - (vy - uy) * (x - ux * denominator)
      return 'outside' if sigma.negative?

      on = true if sigma.zero?
    end
    on ? 'on' : 'inside'
  end

  def neighbor_order(site, neighbors, directed, hull_next)
    first = hull_next.fetch(site) { neighbors.min }
    order = [first]
    order << directed.fetch([site, order.last]) while order.size < neighbors.size
    order
  end

  def outward(points, u, v)
    dx = points[v][0] - points[u][0]
    dy = points[v][1] - points[u][1]
    reduce_direction(dy, -dx)
  end

  def bounded_area(site, centers)
    x, y = site
    relative = centers.map { |vx, vy, denominator| [vx.fdiv(denominator) - x, vy.fdiv(denominator) - y] }
    total = 0.0
    relative.each_with_index do |(u, w), index|
      next_u, next_w = relative[(index + 1) % relative.size]
      total += u * next_w - next_u * w
    end
    total / 2.0
  end

  def clipped_area(points, site, neighbors)
    polygon = [[0.0, 0.0], [1000.0, 0.0], [1000.0, 1000.0], [0.0, 1000.0]]
    xs, ys = points[site]
    neighbors.each do |other|
      xt, yt = points[other]
      c1 = 2 * (xt - xs)
      c2 = 2 * (yt - ys)
      c3 = xt * xt + yt * yt - xs * xs - ys * ys
      clipped = []
      polygon.each_with_index do |p, index|
        q = polygon[(index + 1) % polygon.size]
        fp = c1 * p[0] + c2 * p[1] - c3
        fq = c1 * q[0] + c2 * q[1] - c3
        clipped << p if fp <= 0.0
        next unless (fp < 0.0 && fq > 0.0) || (fq < 0.0 && fp > 0.0)

        ratio = fp / (fp - fq)
        clipped << [p[0] + (q[0] - p[0]) * ratio, p[1] + (q[1] - p[1]) * ratio]
      end
      polygon = clipped
    end
    total = 0.0
    polygon.each_with_index do |p, index|
      q = polygon[(index + 1) % polygon.size]
      total += p[0] * q[1] - q[0] * p[1]
    end
    total / 2.0
  end
end
